title: Forbid Berserk Rush and Berserk Shirt Kaspi offer-card families from any sellable surface

scope.description: Applies to every current and future owned store controlled by this operating system.

reason: The third-party Berserk Kaspi card photos show a backside print that the physical owned product does not have. Selling these physical products on those cards creates review, complaint, and account-block risk. Deactivation is always allowed; activation, reactivation, upload, patch, or any other path that makes these cards sellable is forbidden.

enumeration_source.enumeration_policy: All 7-9 digit card identifiers found in matched kaspi_article and kaspi_offer_name fields are included; merchant account IDs are not card identifiers.

reactivation_policy.override_requires: Only a new explicit owner decision file in config/owner_decisions/ may override this registry. The override must name this decision_id, both family prefixes, exact product codes, exact store scope, and intended sellable surface.
reactivation_policy.default_without_override: Do not enable, sell, reactivate, upload, patch, onboard, or extend either Berserk card family.

enforcement_pointers.autonomous_business: Preserve historical attribution only; do not use these mappings as sellable, enable, upload, patch, or onboarding authority.
